scenario: The ego vehicle approaches and overtakes a slower moving vehicle in the same lane on a straight road.

ego.behavior: The car travels straight forward along its lane and overtakes a slower vehicle ahead by moving into the adjacent lane and returning to the original lane.

adversarials.behavior: The car travels straight forward in the same lane at a slower speed than the ego vehicle, maintaining its lane position throughout the scenario.

spatial_relation: The ego vehicle and the adversarial vehicle are both positioned on a straight multi-lane road, with the adversarial vehicle initially ahead of the ego vehicle in the same lane.
requirements_and_restrictions: The ego vehicle must approach the slower adversarial vehicle from behind and complete the overtaking maneuver; the scenario terminates once the ego vehicle has passed the adversarial vehicle and returned to its original lane.
